KEY FEATURES:

 

  • Best Material: 
    - Glass: Our phone case is made of high quality tempered glass case which scratch-proof and shockproof. Note that this glass case may break when dropped like any glass products. So please be careful not let the case dropped. This case has soft silicone edge and grid pattern design.

    - Silicone: Our phone case is made of soft TPU of excellent quality which prevents your phone slipping out of your hand, or off the table, soft to touch and good grip when holding it. It offers better soft handle feeling than traditional cases. The ultra slim fit and skin-friendly case is specially designed and will bring you a different using experience with a stunning hand feeling. The features of super thin & light realize the quick wireless charging.

 

  • Comfortability: 
    -Glass: The glass phone case has highly accurate holes for charging or listening equipment, flexible buttons and extra hole for phone strap. So it become easy for you to hang your phone in anywhere for indoor or outdoor activities.

 

  • - Silicone: The silicon phone case has protective microfiber lining, soft-touch finish for comfortable grip and protective button covers. It is compatible for any kind of phones, which will perfectly fits your phone with precise cutouts for all buttons and ports.

 

  • Protect your phone: 
    - Glass: Glass case will protect camera from scratching. You can easily clean your phone case by using glass clean water, making your phone looks new for a long time.

 

  • -Silicone: Perfectly protects your mobile phone from bumps, scratches, dirt, oil and other damage. It is easy to wipe off dust and dirt on this silicone phone case with a damp rag. Keeping any stains away when you use the phone. It can make your phone always fresh and clean.

 

  • Easy to Installation: Quick installation and fit perfectly.

 

  • Customization: All design are made to order and are unique. You can give us your picture and to express yourself or your love to special ones with an engraved pen made special just for you or them. Our 3D printed technology will make your picture durable.

 

  • A gift of love: A perfect idea if you are finding a birthday gift, a housewarming gift, a festival gift, a Mother’s Day/ Father’s Day/ Christmas gift for your family or friends.

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here
  • Template and mockup file guideline video

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product. 

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.

 

  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
